description_target.target_text: stamp source-panel templates onto sparse target-panel markers, preferring larger anchor matches

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; The board splits into two halves (along whichever axis makes the
 ;; content most lopsided): a SOURCE half full of multicolor objects
 ;; and a TARGET half of sparse anchor dots. Slide each source object
 ;; so that ALL its cells of some color land exactly on same-color
 ;; dots; among valid placements, more matched anchors win (then
 ;; bigger objects, then earlier objects), each dot used once. Output
 ;; the target half with the placed objects painted in.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (grid-mode-all x) (mode-list (apply append x)))
     (define (count-non-bg x bg)
       (count-if (lambda (p) (not (= (at x (first p) (second p)) bg)))
                 (grid-positions x)))
     (define (halves-info a b)  ;; (a b a-bg b-bg content-asymmetry)
       (let ((abg (grid-mode-all a)) (bbg (grid-mode-all b)))
         (list a b abg bbg
               (abs (- (count-non-bg a abg) (count-non-bg b bbg))))))
     (define vt
       (and (zero? (modulo w 2))
            (halves-info (subgrid g 0 0 (- h 1) (- (quotient w 2) 1))
                         (subgrid g 0 (quotient w 2) (- h 1) (- w 1)))))
     (define ht
       (and (zero? (modulo h 2))
            (halves-info (subgrid g 0 0 (- (quotient h 2) 1) (- w 1))
                         (subgrid g (quotient h 2) 0 (- h 1) (- w 1)))))
     (define halves
       (if (> (if ht (fifth ht) -1) (if vt (fifth vt) -1)) ht vt))
     (define a-fuller?
       (>= (count-non-bg (first halves) (third halves))
           (count-non-bg (second halves) (fourth halves))))
     (define src (if a-fuller? (first halves) (second halves)))
     (define tgt (if a-fuller? (second halves) (first halves)))
     (define src-bg (if a-fuller? (third halves) (fourth halves)))
     (define tgt-bg (if a-fuller? (fourth halves) (third halves)))
     (define th (rows tgt))
     (define tw (cols tgt))
     (define objs (objects-multicolor src src-bg))
     (define candidates
       ;; every dedup'd translation putting all of an object's
       ;; color-anchors onto same-color dots, whole object in bounds;
       ;; candidate = (n-anchors size oi dr dc cells anchor-targets)
       (for/fold ((acc (list))) ((oi (range 0 (length objs))))
         (let* ((cells (map (lambda (p)
                              (list (first p) (second p)
                                    (at src (first p) (second p))))
                            (obj-cells (list-ref objs oi))))
                (size (length cells)))
           (for/fold ((a2 acc)) ((color (remove-duplicates
                                         (map third cells))))
             (let ((targets  ;; reversed row-major, like the original
                    (reverse (filter (lambda (p)
                                       (= (at tgt (first p) (second p))
                                          color))
                                     (grid-positions tgt))))
                   (anchors (map (lambda (cv) (list (first cv) (second cv)))
                                 (filter (lambda (cv) (= (third cv) color))
                                         cells))))
               (if (null? targets)
                   a2
                   (second
                    (for/fold ((st (list (list) a2)))
                              ((pr (for*/list ((an anchors) (t targets))
                                     (list an t))))
                      (let* ((dr (- (first (second pr))
                                    (first (first pr))))
                             (dc (- (second (second pr))
                                    (second (first pr))))
                             (key (list dr dc)))
                        (if (and (not (member key (first st)))
                                 (all? (lambda (aa)
                                         (member (list (+ (first aa) dr)
                                                       (+ (second aa) dc))
                                                 targets))
                                       anchors)
                                 (all? (lambda (cv)
                                         (in-bounds? (+ (first cv) dr)
                                                     (+ (second cv) dc)
                                                     th tw))
                                       cells))
                            (list (cons key (first st))
                                  (cons (list (length anchors) size oi
                                              dr dc cells
                                              (map (lambda (aa)
                                                     (list (+ (first aa)
                                                              dr)
                                                           (+ (second aa)
                                                              dc)))
                                                   anchors))
                                        (second st)))
                            st))))))))))
     (define ranked
       (sort candidates
             (lambda (x y)
               (cond ((> (first x) (first y)) #t)
                     ((< (first x) (first y)) #f)
                     ((> (second x) (second y)) #t)
                     ((< (second x) (second y)) #f)
                     (else (< (third x) (third y)))))))
     (first  ;; greedy paint: skip placements whose dots are taken
      (for/fold ((st (list (empty-grid th tw tgt-bg) (list))))
                ((cand ranked))
        (if (any? (lambda (p) (member p (second st))) (seventh cand))
            st
            (list (for/fold ((gg (first st))) ((cv (sixth cand)))
                    (set-cell gg (+ (first cv) (fourth cand))
                              (+ (second cv) (fifth cand))
                              (third cv)))
                  (append (seventh cand) (second st)))))))))
